description: [PREMIUM — needs an API key: call hl_request_free_key first for a free key, or pay per call via x402] Find wallets in a cohort that hold near-identical directional exposure right now (high cosine similarity of their position vectors) — likely the same entity, a copy-bot, or a coordinated group.
